repo:objectstack#4 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYmRepQK9DkZeU7F53D

Final head for L1 · area a4-U · 2026-11-25T07:44Z
Head-sha: `b589350393d7b76fbc59802bfe04966838609f07`

- Premise, with one correction. The bar's end padding (`!pb-[calc(3.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]`) sits on the inset, which is the element that scrolls, not on the route slot. A scroll container's end padding only follows its in-flow content, and that content was the fixed `h-full` route slot. A taller page overflowed the slot, so the scroll ended at the page's bottom, under the bar.
- Fix (`ConsoleLayout.tsx`): on the bar's home and approvals pages, the route slot grows with its page. It is a one-track grid (`grid h-auto min-h-full grid-cols-[minmax(0,1fr)]`), so it is never shorter than the inset, and the existing padding lands after the last row.
  - The inbox list keeps the fixed slot. It is an object list page that sizes itself and scrolls its own rows; the dev measured that a growing slot would turn that into a page scroll.
  - The choice is per route (`phoneTabOf !== 'notifications'`), explained in the code comment and the PR.
  - The padding class did not move, so the existing #35882 pins are untouched.
- Pin: a top-level `describe` in `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx` covering home and approvals grow, the inbox stays fixed, and controls at other widths and routes. Tests 18 of 18. Ablating the fix turns the home and approvals pin red (1 of 18); it was restored.
- Browser, showcase on iPhone 13 (390×664; the bar spans 607–664):
  - Before: on app home the menu's bottom is at 640, 33 px under the bar.
  - After: the menu's bottom is at 584, 23 px above the bar. Approvals likewise.
  - The inbox list and the account list are unchanged.
- Readings, from the dev: app-shell layout suites 1424 tests passed; type-check exit 0; 38 gate families all exit 0; overlap-check clean before every push.
- Acceptance note: the bar is 57 px tall, but the inset reserves 56 px, so a page root's trailing padding ends 1 px under the bar's top. No content sits there.
- Check-runs at this head: 38 success, 13 skipped, 0 failing or pending. Size +89/-2. Not governed. No spec change, so no L2 is owed.
- Handed to the seat session for L1. This zone does not ready or queue the PR before an ACCEPT on this head.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · L1 · head `b589350393d7b76fbc59802bfe04966838609f07` · 2026-11-25T08:19Z

- Shape: draft, base `main`, head `b589350393d7b76fbc59802bfe04966838609f07`, 3 files, +89/−2 (one changeset, `ConsoleLayout.tsx`, the existing `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483` harness). No governed path, no `packages/spec/**`, no `content/docs/releases/`. First line `Fixes #36792`; no other card number appears anywhere in the body.
- Premise: the card's mechanism is wrong and the PR corrects it. At merge base `a03c3d4e`, `ConsoleLayout.tsx:339` puts `!pb-[calc(3.5rem+env(safe-area-inset-bottom))]` on the inset (the `overflow-y-auto` element, the slot's parent), not on the slot. The defect itself holds: the fixed `h-full` route slot is the inset's only in-flow content, so a taller page overflows it and the scroll ends at the page's bottom. The correction is on the card in the os-dev-report comment 7155823958 and in the PR's What changes. The card's outcome (the last row of a long page clears the bar) is delivered on every route that draws the bar, so `Fixes` is the right keyword.
- Check-runs at head: 51 total, 38 success, 13 skipped, 0 failure or pending. Lint & Repo Gates, TypeScript Type Check, Type Check UI, Test UI (the aggregate and the 9 shards listed at head), Build & E2E UI, Live E2E UI and Check Changeset are all success. The skipped runs are core, docs, dogfood and opt-in legs that this ui-only diff does not plan.
- K = 10 (merge base `a03c3d4e` .. `origin/main` `d62f9e9c` 2026-11-25T07:25Z). Under 15. `main` has not touched the three files since the merge base.
- Merge-tree against `origin/main`: clean, tree `af2d4172`, no conflicts.
- Overlap: I read the file lists of all 40 other open PRs. None touches `ConsoleLayout.tsx`, `PhoneAppNavBar.tsx`, `PhoneAppHome.tsx`, the `-28483` harness or the changeset path. The nearest is #37241, which edits a sibling test (`ConsoleLayout.noTopBar-36112.test.tsx`), not these files.
- Pin re-run in a throwaway worktree at head (full frozen install; `@objectstack/spec`, `lint` and `client` built first): `ConsoleLayout.phoneRecordOneBar-28483.test.tsx` passed 18/18.
- Ablation 1 (`phoneSlotGrows = false && …`) gave 1 failed / 17 passed. The red case is "at 375 px the app home and the approvals inbox grow the slot". After restore, the blob is `2ae15314`, the same as HEAD.
- Ablation 2 (mine; drops the inbox exclusion, `phoneSlotGrows = phoneNavBar`) gave 1 failed / 17 passed. The red case is "the inbox list keeps the fixed slot". So both halves of the route rule are pinned. Restored to `2ae15314`.
- App-shell layout suites at head (`vitest run packages/app-shell/src/layout/`): 164 files and 1424 tests passed, exit 0. This matches the dev's count.
- Root cause, not a mask. The scroller's end padding follows in-flow content, so the slot now sizes to its page. It is a one-track grid with `min-h-full` and `h-auto`; `cn` merges away `h-full`, and the pin asserts that. A page root's `h-full` still resolves against the stretched row. On a phone, the slot's only other child is `ShellSidebarExpandFallback`, which returns `null` when `isMobile` (below 768 px, the same breakpoint as `usePhoneViewport`). So no second grid row splits the stretch.
- Other phone tabs: the inbox list (`sys_inbox_message`) keeps the fixed slot because it bounds itself and scrolls its own rows. The PR's readings show it unchanged (616 / footer 600). Phone routes without the bar draw no bar and have no end inset, so there is nothing to clear.
- Desktop and tablet are unaffected: `phoneSlotGrows` requires `phone`. The CONTROL case pins the fixed slot at 768 and 1440 px on bar routes. The inset's padding class is untouched, so the #35882 pins stand.
- Browser readings were taken from the PR, not re-measured. On iPhone 13 (bar 607–664), the home menu bottom moved from 640 (33 px under the bar) to 584 (23 px above). Approvals scrollHeight went from 753 to 809, with the lowest element moving from 607.67 to 551.67. The 56 px delta matches `3.5rem` on both routes.
- The 1 px bar/inset gap is confirmed in source: `h-12`, `pt-1`, `pb-[calc(0.25rem+…)]` and `border-t` make 57 px, against 56 px reserved. Only a page root's empty padding sits in that pixel. It was declared in the PR and is out of scope.
- Changeset, sentence by sentence: the headline (home or approvals, last row out from under the bar) matches `phoneSlotGrows`. "Keeps the bar's height as end padding" is true to within that 1 px. The `h-full` overflow mechanism matches the merge-base code and the home reading. "Grows with its page, never shorter than the inset" matches `grid h-auto min-h-full`. "A short page or an empty state still fills the inset" follows from the grid's stretched row, but only the browser reading shows it, not the pin. "The inbox list … every route without the bar and every route from 768 px up" keep the fixed slot: the second and CONTROL cases pin this. The level is `patch` for `@object-ui/app-shell`, the same convention as other app-shell changesets on `main`.
- `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` start their lines in both the PR body and the changeset body. Both are correct: the diff is a layout class in the console shell and changes no accepted set and nothing a metadata author can write. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed, and no L2 is owed.
- S1 (should-fix) — 维护者速读 line 2 says the fix covers the scroll padding of three bar pages (首页、通知、审批). The diff deliberately exempts 通知 (the inbox list keeps the fixed slot), and the PR's own readings show it unchanged. Rewrite the line to name only 首页和审批, and say that 通知 already scrolls inside its own list. Change it in the PR body and in the seat's final 速读 comment before landing. This is a text-only edit and does not move the head.
- N1 — 速读 line 1 attaches "以前最底下约 33 像素被挡住" to both pages. The 33 px reading is the home page's. On approvals, the PR's before-reading puts the lowest element only 0.67 px under the bar. The zone note's "Approvals likewise" says the same. Scope the 33 px to 首页 when you fix S1.
- N2 — Two comments in `ConsoleLayout.tsx` that the PR left alone are now partly stale. The #34594 note on the inset says "a taller page scrolls its last row out from under the bar (a scroll container's end padding scrolls)", which held only once this fix landed and holds only on the growing routes. The #12463 note on the slot says "It is a block box … the inset scrolls it exactly as before", but on the phone home and approvals pages the slot is now a grid. Update both at the next touch.
- N3 — `phoneTabOf(...) !== 'notifications'` is a deny-list. A fourth bar tab would get the growing slot by default, even if it were a self-bounding list. An allow-list (`'home' | 'approvals'`) would fail safe. This is optional.
- Landing: the zone first fixes S1 (and N1) in the PR body only; the head does not move. Then it lands after measuring K; if K ≥ 15 it merges main first; a merge-only head move keeps this ACCEPT.
